title: Auto-Suggest Keywords for Snippets
description: Intelligent keyword suggestion powered by Ollama that analyzes snippet content and existing keyword patterns to suggest short, memorable trigger keywords. Learns from existing keywords and can audit/refactor the entire library.

title: US-001: Analyze existing keyword patterns
description:
As a user, I want the system to analyze my existing keywords so that new suggestions follow my established style.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Create `analyzeKeywordPatterns()` function in `/src/lib/keyword-analysis.ts`
- [ ] Scan all snippets with keywords from store on app initialization
- [ ] Extract patterns: common prefixes (!, @, //, etc.), average length, naming conventions
- [ ] Return style guide object: `{ prefix?: string, maxLength?: number, case?: 'lower'|'upper'|'camel', examples: Array<{name, keyword}> }`
- [ ] Store inferred style guide in localStorage key `prompt-workbench-keyword-style`
- [ ] Handle edge case: return sensible defaults when no existing keywords (prefix: '!', maxLength: 6, case: 'lower')
- [ ] Add `useKeywordStyle` hook that loads/caches the style guide
- [ ] npx tsc --noEmit passes
- [ ] pnpm lint passes

title: US-002: Create Ollama keyword suggestion API
description:
As a user, I want Ollama to generate contextually appropriate keyword suggestions based on snippet content.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Create `/src/app/api/suggest-keyword/route.ts` POST endpoint
- [ ] Request body: `{ name: string, text: string, styleGuide: StyleGuide }`
- [ ] Prompt includes: snippet name, snippet text (truncated to 500 chars if longer), style guide rules
- [ ] Prompt includes 3-5 existing name→keyword pairs from styleGuide.examples as few-shot examples
- [ ] Request 5 suggestions ranked by relevance
- [ ] Response: `{ suggestions: string[], model: string }`
